description: Removes the sending domain from this workspace. Destructive: campaigns cannot be scheduled from it afterwards, and adding it back gives new DNS records to set up again. Refused with domain_in_use while a campaign is scheduled on it. Uses no quota. Only call when the person explicitly asked to remove this exact domain. Requires API key scope: account.

confirm.description: Must be true, and only after the person explicitly asked to remove this domain.

domain.description: A sending domain or subdomain, for example mail.example.com. No https://, no path.

name: domain_remove
title: Remove sending domain
